audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[2] reads "Kite and zone with canvas terrain to keep you locked out of range all game" — Hwei creates NO terrain. It is a fabricated mechanic, and this same matchup's own late paragraph and spikes[3] both say so explicitly ("Hwei creates no terrain — what he zones with is damage on the ground").
audit.why: Nothing in Hwei's kit carries the terrain flag; his zoning is damage painted on the ground, which is a completely different interaction — it does not block paths and it does not stop Aurora's leaps. Leaving the line in tells the reader to route around walls that do not exist, and contradicts the page two fields later. The rest of the interaction set is correct and I verified it: the passive primes on the first damaging spell and completes on the second (winCon, enemyWin, early, breakdown.carry all state this), Subject: Torment carries every piece of his CC on one 12s palette, and Spiraling Despair strikes the first champion at 1300 and expands from them — correctly stated as NOT a fear in spikes[1] and mid.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[2] -> "Zone you off the wave with painted damage until his palettes come back up"
sources: hwei kit — no terrain flag on any slot

audit.why: The crash window here is Subject: Torment, 12s at rank 1 — with that palette spent he has no crowd control at all, so nothing punishes the crash.
audit.corrected: Crash timing: crash while Subject: Torment is on its 12-second cooldown, then reset.
